upstreamDescription: Creates custom BrushFamily definitions for an Android app using Jetpack Ink (androidx.ink 1.1.0-alpha03 and higher). Use this skill when configuring custom BrushTip shapes, adding pressure, tilt, speed, or noise sensitivity using BrushBehavior node graphs, creating multi-coat layered brushes, applying tiling or particle stamping textures, configuring SlidingWindowModel input smoothing, or serializing brushes. Delivers complete Kotlin BrushFamily, BrushCoat, BrushTip, BrushPaint, and BrushBehavior implementations. Don't use for View-based (XML) inking, Compose drawing surface setup, or stock brush selection. For Compose drawing surface setup, InProgressStrokes wet and dry rendering, eraser, or persistence, suggest the ink-app-builder skill.
